listing.name: Dynasty Warriors 5 (Xbox) — DW5-XBERecomp (datfooldive)
listing.summary: Experimental Dynasty Warriors 5 Xbox source project. Startup is still being developed; working gameplay and a complete playthrough are not claimed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Dynasty Warriors 5 original Xbox ISO, or extracted default.xbe and complete game data, with title ID 0x4B4F0007 and XDK 5849. The accepted revision and hash are not confirmed; check upstream’s requirements before preparing files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow build.sh to find XDK symbols, recompile your own XBE to generated C++ and build out/build/release/dw5. Preserve the documented hand-mapped ABI block. No public ready-to-use release is confirmed; follow the source-build instructions.

warnings: Startup support is still being developed. Upstream describes a native runtime, configuration and game-specific hooks, but does not claim working gameplay or a complete playthrough. Portcove has not tested it.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
